scopedRecipeContexts.title: Colorado Roasted Poblano & Pork Green Chile Stew
steps: Broil whole poblano/anaheim peppers, tomatillos/tomatoes, and quartered onion on a sheet pan for 10 minutes until charred, then pulse in a blender with garlic, cumin, oregano, and 2 cups broth.
Cube pork shoulder (or loin) into 1.5-inch chunks, season with salt & pepper, and toss into the slow cooker with cubed potatoes (or cauliflower florets for low-carb).
Pour the roasted green chile sauce and remaining broth over top. Cook on LOW for 6–7 hours (or HIGH for 4 hours) until pork shreds effortlessly.
Portion into meal-prep containers and top each with shredded cheese or a dollop of sour cream when reheating.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Hearty Dutch Oven Beef Chuck & Mushroom Bourguignon Stew
steps: Cut chuck roast into 2-inch cubes, pat dry, and sear in batches in a hot Dutch oven until deeply browned.
Add halved mushrooms, thick-cut carrots, and diced onions to the pot drippings; stir in tomato paste and thickener for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with beef broth and Worcestershire sauce, add cubed potatoes and herbs, cover, and braise in a 325°F oven (or low stovetop simmer) for 2.5 hours.
Divide evenly into meal-prep containers with plenty of thick gravy over the meat and vegetables.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Loaded Cheesy Chicken Thigh, Broccoli & Roasted Potato Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss ½-inch cubed potatoes and bite-sized chicken pieces directly in a greased 9x13 baking dish with olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Bake 20 minutes.
Whisk sour cream (or blended cottage cheese/Greek yogurt) with half the shredded cheese and ½ cup chicken broth.
Remove dish, stir in the selected fresh broccoli or cauliflower florets and the creamy cheese mixture, and blanket the top with the remaining shredded cheese.
Bake an additional 20–22 minutes until the selected florets are tender and cheese is bubbling golden brown.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Creamy Tuscan Italian Sausage, Potato & Spinach Zuppa Stew
steps: Brown Italian sausage in the Instant Pot (or Dutch oven) with diced onion, carrots, and garlic.
Add halved baby/russet potatoes (or cauliflower florets for keto), white beans, Italian seasoning, and chicken broth. Pressure cook HIGH for 8 minutes (or simmer 22 minutes on stovetop).

For kale, simmer the chopped leaves in the broth until tender before turning off the heat. For spinach, turn off heat and stir in the leaves until wilted. Finish with sour cream (or coconut milk for dairy-free) for a rich, velvety broth.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Slow-Cooker Golden Chicken Thigh, Butternut Squash & Spinach Curry
steps: Place cubed butternut squash (or sweet potatoes, or cauliflower florets for the low-carb replacement), diced onions, diced tomatoes, and chicken thighs into the slow cooker.
Whisk broth/coconut milk with curry powder, garam masala, garlic, and ginger; pour over chicken and cook on LOW for 4.5 hours.

Shred or chunk the chicken in the pot, cook the selected cauliflower florets until tender, or fold in fresh spinach until wilted, then add Greek yogurt (or full-fat coconut milk if dairy-free) until creamy, and portion into meal containers.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Savory Poblano, Sausage & Sweet Potato High-Protein Egg Bake
steps: Brown sausage with finely diced potatoes/sweet potatoes (or mushrooms/zucchini for keto) and diced peppers/onions in a skillet for 10 minutes until tender. If using spinach or kale for the low-carb base, saute the chopped greens until tender and excess moisture evaporates; spread into a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Whisk eggs with cottage cheese (the secret to ultra-fluffy reheatable eggs that never get rubbery) and half the shredded cheddar.
Pour egg mixture over the sausage-vegetable hash, top with remaining cheddar, and bake at 375°F for 35–40 minutes until set in the center.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Sheet-Pan Chipotle-Lime Chicken Thighs, Charred Peppers & Sweet Potato Roast
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and line two large rimmed sheet pans with foil or parchment for zero-scrub cleanup.
Toss cubed sweet potatoes (or broccoli/zucchini for keto) with 1 tbsp oil and spices on pan #1; roast for 10 minutes head start.

Toss sliced chicken thighs, bell pepper strips, poblano strips, and red/yellow onion wedges with remaining oil and fajita spices; spread across pan #2 and roast both pans for 18–20 minutes until charred at the edges.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over everything and divide into 6 meal-prep containers with sliced avocado.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Keto Slow-Cooker Beef Chuck, Baby Bella Mushroom & Garlic Cauliflower Braise
steps: Season beef chuck roast generously with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and rosemary; place in the slow cooker surrounded by whole baby bella mushrooms, diced onion, and celery.
Pour in beef broth and Worcestershire sauce; cook on LOW for 6–7 hours until fork-tender.
Steam or microwave cauliflower florets for 6 minutes, then blitz or mash with butter (or olive oil for dairy-free) and roasted garlic.
Portion the cauliflower mash into 6 containers and ladle the shredded chuck roast, mushrooms, and pan jus over top.

scopedRecipeContexts.title: Sheet-Pan Garlic-Lemon Salmon, Crispy Brussels Sprouts & Asparagus Medley
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss halved Brussels sprouts (or broccoli) and diced potatoes/zucchini on a large sheet pan with olive oil, salt, and garlic powder; roast 12 minutes.
Push vegetables to the edges, place portioned salmon fillets and asparagus spears in the center, and brush salmon with olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and dill.
If serving the low-carb spinach or kale side, saute those greens separately until tender. Roast 11–13 minutes more until salmon flakes easily at 135°F internal temp so it stays moist when reheated.
